they store fat in their humps

Water can be a solid, a liquid or a gas. Ice is water that is frozen solid. When ice warms up, it melts into liquid water. When water boils, some of it changes into invisible water vapor. The white mist above a hot pot is made of tiny liquid water droplets that form as vapor cools.

their wings make a humming sound

Tropical rainforests are warm forests that receive a lot of rain each year. They cover a small part of Earth's land but support many different kinds of plants and animals. The tall trees make a roof of leaves called the canopy. Monkeys, birds and frogs can live high up in the canopy. Some important medicines come from rainforest plants. Volcanoes form where hot melted rock pushes up from deep inside the Earth. When the pressure gets too strong, the volcano erupts. Lava, ash and gas burst out. Some volcanoes erupt often, while others sleep for hundreds of years. Scientists called volcanologists study volcanoes to warn people before an eruption. The islands of Hawaii were made by volcanoes.

Sea turtles hatch from eggs buried in beach sand. The babies often come out of their nests at night. On a naturally dark beach, they crawl toward the brighter, open horizon over the ocean and away from darker dunes. Bright lights from buildings can lead them in the wrong direction. Some beach towns turn off or shield lights during nesting season. Only a few hatchlings survive to adulthood, so protecting their route to the sea matters.
What helps sea turtle hatchlings find the ocean?
Why do towns turn off lights?
